responsibility: Declares the generic NetBSD driver options recognized by GCC—assert=, posix, and pthread. It is the option metadata companion to the NetBSD spec headers, enabling those OS-level switches to participate in command-line decoding and specs expansion.
same_name_distinction: This is the generic NetBSD option metadata file in the netbsd group, declaring assert=, posix, and pthread for driver decoding; gcc/config/netbsd.h supplies the shared NetBSD specs/macros that consume those options, while gcc/config/netbsd.cc is separate code for builtin renaming.
